All requested verifications PASS: (1) zero TypeScript errors in energia/page.tsx via tsc --noEmit (pre-existing errors are in unrelated files: inversor/layout, contratos, marketplace, propiedades, propietarios, rendimiento), (2) zero ESLint issues, (3) 'about:blank' pattern is fully removed from handleConnect (grep returns nothing), (4) lastAuthUrl state declared on line 57 with useState<string | null>(null), (5) copyAuthUrl async function on line 160 using navigator.clipboard.writeText(lastAuthUrl), (6) fallback panel renders only when lastAuthUrl is set ({lastAuthUrl && (...)} guard on line 352), exposing three required testIDs: 'auth-url-open-here' (anchor href={lastAuthUrl} target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer line 362-370), 'auth-url-copy' (button onClick={copyAuthUrl} line 372-378), 'auth-url-sms' (anchor with sms:?&body= URI line 380-386, message and URL URL-encoded). rca_of_issue: Original bug (now FIXED): in iOS Safari, the previous code called window.open('about:blank','_blank') synchronously to reserve the user-gesture, then redirected the popup after an async fetch resolved. iOS Safari blocks programmatic cross-origin navigation of a same-origin (about:blank) popup after the gesture context is lost, leaving a permanent blank tab. New code (lines 129-158) skips the about:blank reservation entirely: it fetches the URL first, then either (a) calls window.open(authUrl,'_blank') in the same try/catch (which may be blocked on iOS but that's now acceptable), and (b) always renders a visible <a target=_blank> with the real URL — clicking that anchor is a fresh user gesture so iOS Safari opens it reliably. Plus copy+SMS share fallbacks. Verified: no 'about:blank' string anywhere in the file.
